text: MongoDB documents `serverStatus.bucketCatalog` as instance-level time-series metrics. `$collStats` exposes `storageStats.timeseries` only when the `storageStats` option is specified; the manual’s time-series example uses `storageStats: {}` for the default scale, and the option also permits `storageStats: { scale: <number> }`. For a sharded collection, `$collStats` returns one document per shard, so interpret the outputs at their own scopes. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23)
keywords: serverStatus bucketCatalog and collStats timeseries counters

text: MongoDB defines `numBucketsClosedDueToMemoryThreshold` as closures when active buckets exceed the allowed bucket catalog cache size; `numBucketsClosedDueToCachePressure` counts closures when a bucket exceeds a dynamic size limit derived from storage-engine cache availability and `numBuckets`, which differs from the maximum bucket size limit. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20)
keywords: serverStatus bucketCatalog and collStats timeseries counters

text: The `bucketCatalog` documentation distinguishes state measures such as `numBuckets`, `numOpenBuckets`, `numIdleBuckets`, and `memoryUsage` from event counts such as `numBucketInserts`, `numBucketUpdates`, `numCommits`, `numWaits`, and `numMeasurementsCommitted`. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20)
keywords: serverStatus bucketCatalog and collStats timeseries counters

text: `numBucketInserts` counts new buckets and `numBucketUpdates` counts updates to existing buckets; MongoDB's design README says the first committed write batch inserts a bucket and later batches update it. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20)
keywords: serverStatus bucketCatalog and collStats timeseries counters

text: MongoDB describes the `$collStats` time-series fields as internal diagnostic data; the collection-level document includes bucket counters that overlap with `serverStatus.bucketCatalog` but uses a different schema. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20)
keywords: serverStatus bucketCatalog and collStats timeseries counters
